actions: Inspected existing browser tabs and processes before opening one task-owned preview tab.
Opened Automation and selected Trade Station through a real browser control.
Verified the initial currency and goods labels in the rendered Trade Station panel.
Unselected Fixture Market Credit through its checkbox.
Selected the visible Fixture Resource Crate card through a real browser click.
Toggled Show city-owner exclusive on and then off through its checkbox.
Closed only the task-owned preview tab.
observed: Purchase currencies rendered Fixture Trade Token followed by Fixture Market Credit, with both initially checked.
Fixture Speedup Chest rendered Possible cost: Fixture Trade Token / Fixture Market Credit; Fixture Resource Crate rendered Possible cost: Fixture Trade Token.
After Fixture Market Credit was unselected, Fixture Trade Token remained checked and became disabled as the last-currency guard.
Fixture Resource Crate became checked through the production selection path while its currency label remained Fixture Trade Token.
With Show city-owner exclusive enabled, Fixture City-Owner Offer appeared disabled with Possible cost: Fixture Market Credit and the skipped-exclusive label.
After Show city-owner exclusive was disabled again, Fixture City-Owner Offer was hidden while the non-exclusive goods and their labels remained intact.
